original_target.title: Uniqueness of tangent cones for stationary integral varifolds

scope_comparison: The published 2026 theorem concerns multiplicity-one cylindrical cones. Its former area-minimizing hypothesis was removed, so that is not the exclusion. Other new results require a flat-density gap or change the smooth ambient metric; none gives every-point Euclidean tangent-cone uniqueness for the stated general stationary integral varifolds.

primary_sources.locator: Theorem 1.1, changed smooth ambient metric and multiplicity two plane
